## otakumode.com (Information)

- https://otakumode.com/otapedia/games/final_fantasy/final_fantasy_7_remake -- story, differences -- accessed 2026-10-17
  - (fetched by me, text pasted by user; Tokyo Otaku Mode's Otapedia, sections Movies, Final Fantasy VII Remake Plot, Characters, Gameplay, Main Differences to the Original, Development, Trivia)
  - **written before the release and never updated (user, 2026-10-17)**
  - it calls the game "upcoming", gives the release as March 2020 on the PlayStation 4, and says the plot will "probably" cover only the first part of the original
  - nothing in it is a fact about the released game, so none of it is used
  - Its plot text is the original game's summary (Shinra, Mako, AVALANCHE, Sephiroth)
    - it names the planned multi-part structure, the Unreal Engine 4, real-time party switching and a Classic Mode (automated combat), which are consistent with the released Part 1
  - Its Links section names the official site https://ffvii-remake.square-enix-games.com/en-us (not in our entry before)
    - that address now redirects (302) to https://ffvii.square-enix-games.com/games/remake
    - Wayback captures of the old address run from 2019-05-11 (https://web.archive.org/web/20190511103632/https://ffvii-remake.square-enix-games.com/en-us) to 2025-05-29 (https://web.archive.org/web/20250529133535/https://ffvii-remake.square-enix-games.com/en-us) -- shallow: captures only listed, pages not read

## square-enix.com (Publisher, official)

- https://www.square-enix.com/ffvii/en-us/games/remake/ -- story, scope -- accessed 2026-10-17
  - (page text pasted by user)
  - "What is Final Fantasy VII Remake?": Shinra controls the planet's life force as mako energy, the anti-Shinra group Avalanche resists in Midgar, and Cloud Strife, a former SOLDIER turned mercenary, lends them his aid
  - the first, standalone game of the Remake project covers the story up to the party's escape from Midgar and goes deeper into the events in Midgar than the original
  - its story section follows the bombing of Mako Reactor 1, Cloud's visions of a long-dead enemy and the flower seller
  - agrees with the entry's description (Cloud joins Avalanche against Shinra; covers the story set in Midgar)
  - **the locale stays in this link (user, 2026-10-17): it cannot be removed**
